ctx.x: Okay. There was a teacher, and I‘m going to remember her name in a minute, who was very strict and very mean, and I‘m going to call her name. I want to call her name, damn it. Okay. I was in this Junior School of Music, and there‘s a teacher. Her name is Dr. Francis Hughes, who right now is the number one lady in my life. I mean, we‘re in touch now, and she has so much faith in me. She and my uncle set up something with Howard. [whispering] What was her name, Mrs. Nickerson; I don‘t know if she‘s dead or alive.…
